pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate workloads with equal verification/risk and a precommitted eligible-wake definition. Freeze scheduler cadence/policy between baseline and candidate or normalize by matched wall-clock/workload exposure; candidate-side wake coalescing may not change the denominator.

denominator_integrity.rule: durable_progress_per_wake cannot establish speedup by itself. Numerator and denominator must bind to durable runtime records and be corroborated by verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency.
denominator_integrity.reject: Same accepted durable progress with fewer counted wakes is not speedup unless independent wall-clock closure/latency metrics improve or satisfy preregistered non-inferiority bounds.
